concepts.name: 拉氏变换的线性性质
concepts.formal: 设 $f(t)$ 及 $g(t)$ 都可作拉氏变换，则对于任何两个常数 $\alpha, \beta$ 有 $$\mathrm{L} [ \alpha f (t) + \beta g (t) ] = \alpha \mathrm{L} [ f (t) ] + \beta \mathrm{L} [ g (t) ].$$
concepts.source_quote: 设 $f(t)$ 及 $g(t)$ 都可作拉氏变换，则对于任何两个常数 $\alpha, \beta$ 有 $$\mathrm{L} [ \alpha f (t) + \beta g (t) ] = \alpha \mathrm{L} [ f (t) ] + \beta \mathrm{L} [ g (t) ].$$

concepts.name: 逆变换的线性性质
concepts.formal: 若记 $\mathrm{L}[f(t)] = F(p), \mathrm{L}[g(t)] = G(p)$，写成反变换式就是 $$\begin{array}{r l} \mathrm{L} ^ {- 1} [ \alpha F (p) + \beta G (p) ] & = \alpha f (t) + \beta g (t) \\ & = \alpha \mathrm{L} ^ {- 1} [ F (p) ] + \beta \mathrm{L} ^ {- 1} [ G (p) ]. \end{array}$$ 即逆变换 $L^{-1}$ 也是线性的.
concepts.source_quote: 即逆变换  $L^{-1}$  也是线性的.
